name: ai-hedge-fund-canonical-security-identity-723f
instr:
hedge_fund cannot treat aliases and provider-specific or broker-specific symbols as one economic security. Add local, deterministic identity while preserving requested labels and ticker-only workflows, without duplicating data, orders, or holdings.

`SecurityId`, `SecurityAlias`, `UniverseEntry`, `ResolvedUniverse`, `IdentityResolver`, `IdentityResolutionError`, and `load_security_aliases` are public from `hedge_fund.instruments`; `normalize_universe` from `hedge_fund.fund`, `run_cycle` from `hedge_fund.pipeline`, `build_orders` from `hedge_fund.pipeline.execution`, and `backtest_fund` from `hedge_fund.backtesting` retain their declared call shapes. `load_security_aliases(path)` reads local YAML alias mappings, defaults omitted boundary symbols to canonical, and reports malformed, conflicting, or ambiguous identities as `IdentityResolutionError(ValueError)` with `alias`.

Resolution collapses aliases by canonical identity, preserves first-request order and every requested spelling, and reconciles broker holdings to that identity. Market data uses provider symbols. Caches isolate canonical identities and parameters, and failures create no successful artifact. Portfolio results remain canonical.
